blocks.text: Explore the world of Disney like never before with Bitzee. Bitzee Disney characters respond to swipes, tilts, and taps with sounds and reactions at every interaction. Inside the Bitzee pod, collect 30 characters and experience classic, Pixar and new Disney friends, all in one place. As you interact and play, fill the Star Meter to earn Wishing Stars to attract more characters. Browse the Wish Book to choose a star, wave the pod to make your wish, and when you hear the twinkling sound, open it to reveal a new character. Unlock unique magical moments, including Disney’s Mickey Mouse putting on the Sorcerer’s Hat, Disney’s Flounder escaping the shark, Disney’s Wall-E putting the plant in the boot, Pixar’s Lightning McQueen racing and more. Wish upon the stars to find all 30 characters – once you collect them all, you’ll earn a special reward. Discover Bitzee games with Disney’s Mickey Mouse, Minnie Mouse, Olaf, and Pixar’s Alien, and Nemo, too. Kids, adults, and Disney fans of all ages will be mesmerized with Bitzee’s screen-free innovative twist on 90s toys & games. Must-have Disney gifts and birthday gifts idea. Warning: produces flashes that may trigger epilepsy in sensitised individuals. Includes 3 AA batteries.
